verdict.rationale: Cooley documents a dedicated Cyber/Data/Privacy practice of nearly 100 lawyers globally who counsel on privacy, cybersecurity and data protection, including 400+ privacy and cybersecurity due-diligence reviews in the past year. Its London and Brussels offices suggest a European footprint, but the evidence never names specific regimes. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of GDPR, CCPA or India DPDP Act counseling, any India-specific presence, and independent or community corroboration of the privacy practice.
